title: Admin create-and-publish article UI + improved Articles empty state messaging

requirements.summary: Extend the Admin moderation page with a Create & Publish Article form that calls the admin publish backend capability and refreshes the Articles list.
acceptanceCriteria: AdminModerationPage provides a clearly labeled section to create a new article with inputs for title, author pseudonym, story/body, and anonymity/author name as applicable.
Submitting the form calls the new backend admin publish method and shows a success state.
After success, the UI invalidates/refetches published-articles queries so the new article appears on `/articles` without requiring a hard refresh.
Non-admin users cannot access the creation form (they should see the existing access denied behavior).

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query mutation hook to call the backend capability `adminCreateAndPublishArticle(...)`, with appropriate success/error handling and cache invalidation for published content (e.g., invalidate `['publishedStories']` and any relevant story-detail queries). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: handle admin-only failures gracefully and keep existing access-denied behavior).

Add a clearly labeled "Create & Publish Article" section (or tab) with inputs for title, author pseudonym, story/body, and an anonymity toggle that conditionally shows/uses author name. Wire submit to the new hook, display success state, and ensure non-admins still hit the existing AccessDeniedState behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: admin gating + graceful handling of authorization traps).

requirements.summary: Adjust the Articles page empty-state text to clarify that articles appear after being published, while keeping the submission CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: When there are no published stories, the empty state message mentions that articles will appear after being published (in English).
The existing "Share Your Story" call-to-action remains available for regular users to submit stories.

file_operations.description: Update the empty-state guidance text (English) to explicitly mention that articles show up after being published, while preserving the existing "Share Your Story" button and its navigation behavior.
